label: SpatialFabric scene query
info: Read Examples/OSCSceneQuery/README.md. Configure functionGlobalContext.sfScene once. No Play/Stop/Loop commands are sent.

name: Requires functionGlobalContext.sfScene = require('/absolute/path/scene_query.js')
info: Restart Node-RED after editing settings.js. The module opens an ephemeral UDP reply port and returns complete paginated JSON. Remote Unreal queries require explicit opt-in.

name: OSC chunks → complete scene JSON
Extract playback patch
func:
msg.payload = msg.payload.objects.filter(o => o.kind === 'playback').map(o => ({ actor: o.actor_label, base: o.osc_base, controls: o.controls, device_id: o.configured_device_id, output_channel: o.output_channel, channel_policy: o.channel_policy, playing: o.playing }));
return msg;
